newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indocement to buy Indofood rights.
newsitem.headline: Indocement to buy Indofood rights.

text.p: Indonesian cement maker PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa said its shareholders approved on Thursday a move to buy 50.1 percent of its subsidiary PT Indofood Sukses Makmur's 1.007 trillion rupiah rights issue.
Indocement has a 51.9 percent stake in Indofood. Both noodle maker Indofood and Indocement are members of the Salim Group.
"The funds to buy Indofood's rights issue will come from Indocement's' internal funds," Indocement director Benny Santoso told reporters after Indocement's general shareholders meeting.
Indofood's shareholders earlier on Thursday approved the firm's proposed plan to acquire six firms under the Salim Group.
The shareholders also approved the firm's proposed 5:1 rights issue.
The cost of the acquisitions was expected to reach around 1.55 trillion rupiah. Indofood said the remaining 543 billion rupiah for the acquisitions was expected to come from bank loans.
Santoso said Indofood was expected to account for some 75 percent of Indocement's 1997 revenues and around 30 percent of the Indocement's net profit in 1997.
Santoso declined to give futher details.
